title: What people who've worked with us say
description: Measurable results, not just good intentions.

items.name: Solange Rojas
items.quote: Before SkyCode, we ran WhatsApp Business through three different tools that didn't talk to each other. Now we have a single omnichannel inbox with AI that routes conversations on its own, and the team can see the sales funnel in real time without exporting anything to Excel. What I value most is that we were never dependent on them being available to understand the code — the documentation let us bring part of the maintenance in-house.

items.name: Aguilar
items.quote: We needed a platform that could handle the real volume of the operation, not a pretty demo. SkyCode delivered something functional every week, not promises — and when we asked for an architecture change halfway through, they handled it without it feeling like starting a new project from scratch.

items.name: Gian Caicedo
items.quote: We're a glass and metal company, not a tech company — we needed someone who could explain things without jargon and a site that actually represented the quality of our residential and commercial projects. The delivery timelines were met exactly as agreed.

items.name: Diego Quiroga
items.quote: The online scheduling system took the load off constantly answering the phone to coordinate inspection appointments. The platform stays fast even during peak hours, and post-launch support responded quickly the two times we needed it.

items.name: Jorge Méndez
items.quote: For a fashion and footwear brand, how the site looks matters as much as how it works. SkyCode understood that from the first meeting — the e-commerce site ended up matching the level of the collections we sell, not a generic store with our logo slapped on top.
